description: Urban Water Infrastructure Investment Model (PMA Version) is a model or code deposit deposited in CUAHSI by its authors Adam Wiechman, Sara Alonso Vicario (Arizona State University). The Urban Water Infrastructure Investment Model (UWIIM) is a discrete time dynamical systems model designed to reflect the general flow of water, investment, and information in a stylized urban water coupled infrastructure system. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. Formats: PDF, CSV, Image. Size stated: 39331569 bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page.
